frames.subject: Exactly the same gate as the reference image, refined with crisper construction. A circa-2070 Union-era transit control gate for an evacuation concourse: a cabinet frame in institutional green enamel (#4E5844) and dark steel, a three-arm rotating steel barrier, a top with a blank registry card reader and a small unlit deep-red lamp, on the side a blank riveted near-black type-approval plate edged in deep Union red and a blank round near-black seal boss with a thick deep Union red rim, repeated identical bolts, scuffed kick plate, bolted floor flange. Issued civic manufacture: a Union seal plate in black and red on institutional green, no bone or off-white enamel, no text
